name: Neoconcrete quasi-corpus and phenomenological work
name_zh: 新具体主义准身体与现象学作品观

definitions.thinker: Manifesto of Neoconcrete Art (as quoted by Bois)
definitions.summary: A work of art is not a machine or ordinary object but a quasi-corpus, more than the sum of its elements and fully understood through phenomenological means.
